drafts: Leg 4 ended DNF with 9 touches, all by the trailer's rear-left corner on the left rail, and the same contact kept repeating early in the reverse. Each cycle of pulling forward with hard wheel angles then reversing cost a 5 s penalty and a 4 s gear change, and the forward pull with wheels hard over swung the hitch to about -18 degrees. Watch the left mirror and camera continuously and correct small hitch growth gently, not with full lock. Use only straight forward pulls to clear a contact.

Repeated cycles of forward pull-out with hard wheel lock, then reversing back, caused most contacts and penalties. The hard pull swung the trailer far right and then cost clearance. Priority: one steady, moderate-speed reverse with the trailer rear held well right of centre from the start, set early rather than after a touch. Correct small drift gently and avoid full lock.
